devices.title: Devices & preflight
devices.copy: Manage the profiles that connect cameras, printers, storage, and time health to each edge device.
cards: Profiles, eligible events, camera capability, and printer transport.
Camera, printer, network, storage, clock, payment, and template checks.
Local media retention, disk pressure warning, and safe cleanup rules.

events.title: Events & campaigns
events.copy: Set event windows, eligible devices, entitlement rules, guest session limits, and campaign branding.
cards: Active today · Kemang & Senopati · unlimited event entitlement.
Draft campaign with QRIS, voucher priority, and consent prompt enabled.
Quota, event window, eligible device, cancellation, and session timeout policies.

templates.title: Frame templates
templates.copy: Versioned and immutable frame bundles shared by preview, digital output, video overlay, and print raster.
cards: 2-slot portrait frame with safe areas, dynamic event copy, logo, and claim QR.
Digital composite, thumbnail, thermal raster, and Live Photo manifest use one coordinate space.
Checksum, fonts, asset hash, z-order, dimensions, and placeholders before activation.

vouchers.title: Voucher pool
vouchers.copy: Allocate signed voucher inventory to a device or event and follow its offline ledger through reconciliation.
cards: Exclusive signed allocation scoped to LIL-BOOTH-014 and Kopi Kecil — Launch.
Append-only states: available, reserved, consumed, reconciled, conflict, and quarantined.
Checks config, event, template, clock, storage, and minimum voucher inventory.

queue.title: Queue center
queue.copy: Track jobs that continue safely when the device reconnects: reconciliation, uploads, delivery, and analytics.
cards: Priority follows entitlement reconciliation, session events, media, delivery, then analytics.
Jobs beyond retry policy remain observable and retain safe diagnostic context.
Exponential backoff, jitter, idempotency keys, and durable state across restart.

history.title: Config history
history.copy: Review versioned drafts, effective snapshots, device acknowledgements, before/after diffs, and rollback points.
cards: Published to Kopi Kecil — Launch. Applied to 10 devices; two are waiting for connection.
Available as a safe rollback point for new sessions without redeploying the edge app.
Actor, reason, scope, TTL, effective time, and acknowledgement are retained per revision.

settings.title: Settings & access
settings.copy: Set controls that protect operational configuration without exposing guest media or credentials.
cards: Administrator, operator, support, and engineer actions map to scoped permissions.
Device-bound keys, signed config bundles, certificate rotation, and revocation status.
Control media cache, delivered asset retention, audit logs, and PII masking preferences.

insights.title: Session insights
insights.copy: A proposed reporting surface for operators to compare funnel drop-off, retakes, print outcomes, and delivery health.
insights.note: This screen is an explicitly marked product idea. It is not a committed PRD requirement.
cards: Compare Start → Activation → Capture → Print → Claim by event and device.
Surface average wait, retake rate, and failures around camera or printer recovery.
The PRD requires observability metrics, but it does not specify a dedicated analytics sidebar product.

devices.title: Perangkat & preflight
devices.copy: Kelola profil yang menghubungkan kamera, printer, penyimpanan, dan kesehatan waktu untuk tiap perangkat edge.
cards: Profil, event eligible, kemampuan kamera, dan transport printer.
Pemeriksaan kamera, printer, jaringan, penyimpanan, clock, payment, dan template.
Retensi media lokal, peringatan disk penuh, dan aturan cleanup aman.

events.title: Event & campaign
events.copy: Atur window event, perangkat eligible, aturan entitlement, batas sesi guest, dan branding campaign.
cards: Aktif hari ini · Kemang & Senopati · entitlement event unlimited.
Campaign draft dengan QRIS, prioritas voucher, dan consent prompt aktif.
Kuota, window event, perangkat eligible, cancel, dan timeout sesi.

templates.title: Frame template
templates.copy: Bundle frame berversi dan immutable yang dipakai preview, output digital, video overlay, dan raster print.
cards: Frame portrait 2-slot dengan safe area, copy event dinamis, logo, dan QR claim.
Komposit digital, thumbnail, raster thermal, dan manifest Live Photo memakai satu coordinate space.
Checksum, font, asset hash, z-order, dimensi, dan placeholder sebelum aktivasi.

vouchers.title: Pool voucher
vouchers.copy: Alokasikan inventaris voucher bertanda tangan ke perangkat atau event, lalu pantau ledger offline-nya hingga reconciliation.
cards: Alokasi bertanda tangan eksklusif untuk LIL-BOOTH-014 dan Kopi Kecil — Launch.
State append-only: available, reserved, consumed, reconciled, conflict, dan quarantined.
Memeriksa config, event, template, clock, storage, dan inventaris voucher minimum.

queue.title: Pusat antrean
queue.copy: Pantau job yang dapat berjalan aman saat perangkat tersambung kembali: reconciliation, upload, delivery, dan analytics.
cards: Prioritas mengikuti reconciliation entitlement, session events, media, delivery, lalu analytics.
Job yang melampaui retry policy tetap observable dengan context diagnostik aman.
Backoff eksponensial, jitter, idempotency key, dan state durable saat restart.

history.title: Riwayat config
history.copy: Tinjau draft berversi, snapshot efektif, acknowledgement perangkat, diff before/after, dan titik rollback.
cards: Terbit untuk Kopi Kecil — Launch. Diterapkan pada 10 perangkat; dua menunggu koneksi.
Tersedia sebagai rollback aman bagi sesi baru tanpa redeploy edge app.
Aktor, alasan, scope, TTL, waktu efektif, dan acknowledgement disimpan per revisi.

settings.title: Pengaturan & akses
settings.copy: Atur kontrol yang melindungi konfigurasi operasional tanpa mengekspos media guest atau credential.
cards: Aksi administrator, operator, support, dan engineer mengikuti permission terpisah.
Key terkait perangkat, config bundle signed, rotasi certificate, dan status revocation.
Atur cache media, retensi asset terkirim, audit log, dan preferensi masking PII.

insights.title: Insight sesi
insights.copy: Usulan surface reporting untuk membandingkan funnel drop-off, retake, hasil print, dan kesehatan delivery.
insights.note: Layar ini adalah ide produk yang ditandai secara eksplisit. Ini bukan requirement PRD.
cards: Bandingkan Start → Activation → Capture → Print → Claim per event dan perangkat.
Tampilkan rata-rata tunggu, retake rate, dan kegagalan recovery kamera atau printer.
PRD membutuhkan observability metric, tetapi tidak menyebut produk analytics sidebar tersendiri.
